title: Black Sheep Wall
subtitle: So she mustered the courage and jumped high into the air. That was when the seed was planted in her heart.

trails.title: Trail ① With the City Builder
trails.description: Lead ash, wool and grain, one of these will work on them to some extent.

content.text:
Hunger, silence, the dim light, and a little trouble.
Aside from these elements, a standard guardhouse has to have two other things:
Critters which are not too difficult for kids to handle and tools for the kids to solve the problems.
The interior of the guardhouse will be examined and evaluated regularly, and every week people will come to maintain the facilities and clean it up.
However, some words in childish handwriting were left in the room. They were written on crumpled little notes or on the corner of the wall, look like hints, or were left there for reasons which are unidentifiable now. For some reason, these fragments of information were never completely erased in the frequent cleanings.

items.text: Black Sheep Wall

items.speaker: Principal
items.text: In 388 B.C., standing in the garden paths of the Athens, there was an academia of philosophers.

items.speaker: Principal
items.text: Thirty-six human ideologists present that day were thinking about the ever-present old question, just as you are ...

items.speaker: Principal
items.text: What passes knowledge? What maintains the world's balance?

items.speaker: Principal
items.text: Students, don't forget the exhortation from the philosophers.

items.speaker: All Students
items.text: Heritage, honor, rationality, responsibility!
The principal nods. He holds out his hands like a conductor.

items.speaker: Principal
items.text: This will be your lifelong pursuit.

items.speaker: All Students
items.text: May the peace be with us. May the peace be with mankind!
He's pleased with the responses.

items.speaker: Principal
items.text: Last year, 45% of our graduates were chosen to work in the St. Pavlov Foundation headquarters. A particular excellent student has even been accepted by the House of Integratus.

items.speaker: Principal
items.text: The rest of the children, too, have become front-line investigators, staffs of Foundation office in other countries, or professional soldiers, dedicating themselves to the magnificent cause of mankind.

items.speaker: Principal
items.text: For thousands of years, we have taken in countless young arcanists from workhouses and foundling hospitals, and have raised them to be outstanding students and models in every industry.

items.speaker: Principal
items.text: Soon, you will also be the backbone in preserving world order, and ...

items.speaker: Principal
items.text: ... Hmm?
There is one student standing out in the neat line of students.
She is in the wrong line, or say, she is never in any lines.
Sandwiched in between two neat lines, she looks like a pipe organ stop that has fallen out of place.

items.speaker: Principal
items.text: Do you have any questions, Vertin?

items.speaker: Vertin
items.text: No.

items.speaker: Principal
items.text: Then why aren't you standing in the line?

items.speaker: Vertin
items.text: I'm sorry. I just wanted to see you clearly since your speech was so wonderful.
The principal watches Vertin walking quietly back to the line.

items.speaker: Principal
items.text: Vertin, you are the youngest child we've ever taken in. You were just a month old when you came to the school.

items.speaker: Principal
items.text: And by now, you've spent almost 12 years in here.

items.speaker: Principal
items.text: I'd like to hear your thoughts since you are the most unique child in the school. Whatever the question or opinion is, I will respond with an answer.
She stops.

items.speaker: Vertin
items.text: ... Any ... question?

items.speaker: Principal
items.text: Of course, as you wish.

items.speaker: Vertin
items.text: What is the "Storm," sir?
*a piercing sound*
The School Path

items.speaker: Vertin
items.text: May I ask ... how much further do we have to go?

items.speaker: Instructor
items.text: What?

items.speaker: Vertin
items.text: Till we get to the guardhouse ...

items.speaker: Instructor
items.text: We're almost there. Don't worry.

items.speaker: Vertin
items.text: Ok.

items.speaker: Instructor
items.text: As your punishment, no dinner will be served tonight. You will stay here until tomorrow ... someone picks you up at noon.

items.speaker: Vertin
items.text: Ok.

items.speaker: Instructor
items.text: I won't ask you how you knew "that word." But you have to promise that you won't mention it again.

items.speaker: Vertin
items.text: I promise.

items.speaker: Instructor
items.text: Alright, here we are.

items.speaker: Instructor
items.text: This is not some friendly place. The arcane skills I taught you before may help.

items.speaker: Instructor
items.text: ... I hope you have paid close attention in that class.
The instructor gently pushs her back.

items.speaker: Instructor
items.text: Get inside. Think carefully, or next time it won't be just confinement.
The Guardhouse
A damp, muddy room.
Water keeps dropping onto the ground intermittently.
The ground is covered by old footprints in disarray.
Buzz, buzz.
Something is wiggling in the dark.

items.speaker: Vertin
items.text: This is ...

items.speaker: Vertin
items.text: The Shamir worm?!
Under the dim light, these worms, less than two inches, are crawling across the ground towards here.

items.speaker: Vertin
items.text: So cool.

items.speaker: Vertin
items.text: It's said that the Shamirs are marvelous creatures, even King Solomon searched for them for years. They are incredible engravers—more skilled than the greatest craftsman among human. They can engrave on leaves, metal, and gemstones, build a sacred temple, or destroy a giant vessel.

items.speaker: Vertin
items.text: But now ... they have become tools for punishing naughty kids.
A round Shamir firstly crawls up her calf, interrupting her thoughts. It starts to do its work.

items.speaker: Vertin
items.text: Urgh ...! It hurts.

items.speaker: Vertin
items.text: There are at least a few hundred Shamirs here ... and they are all moving towards me.

items.speaker: Vertin
items.text: The instructor did teach two incantations to repel insects, but Shamirs are not any ordinary worms. They are, in fact, a kind of advanced critter. The elementary arcane skills won't work on them ...

items.speaker: Vertin
items.text: Let alone there are no signs of my arcanum abilities up till now ... Maybe, I'm not an arcanist at all ...
The second Shamir has successfully landed on the moon! They are hardworking twins.

items.speaker: Vertin
items.text: Ouch ...! Please don't bite me two times in a row!

items.speaker: Vertin
items.text: No, stop, I have to focus now. There must be a way I can think of.
Look around.

branch.text: Patting the Shamirs off and thinking.

branch.speaker: Vertin
branch.text: Water keeps dripping down from the side of the ceiling near the window. But, it hasn't rained for days.

branch.speaker: Vertin
branch.text: Here is a thin layer of mud on the ground. Judging from its volume, it's not likely to be brought in by other children who were once here for confinement.

branch.speaker: Vertin
branch.text: The dripping water has made the ground uneven. For these tiny worms, these descending areas are like impassable gulfs.

branch.speaker: Vertin
branch.text: ... Could the ground be left like this so as to slow down the worms and give us the time to cast incantations?

branch.speaker: Vertin
branch.text: But why would they gather around my feet ...?

branch.speaker: Vertin
branch.text: Hmm ... This is ...
It is not mud on the ground. The floor is covered by a heap of grains and corns, which take up one square foot of the room.
Under such dim lights, one can hardly realize that they are standing on a pile of mushy oat brans and corns.

branch.speaker: Vertin
branch.text: Is this their food?

branch.speaker: Vertin
branch.text: Turns out their route has been planned already.
A yellow wool blanket lies in the other corner of the room. No Shamirs have yet approached there.

items.text: Need to find a safe spot first.

branch.text: Patting the Shamirs off and looking around.
A yellow wool blanket lies in the other corner of the room. No Shamirs have ever approached there.

branch.speaker: Vertin
branch.text: Hop to there first.

branch.speaker: Vertin
branch.text: Phew ... Weird, why no Shamirs here?

branch.speaker: Vertin
branch.text: Hm? These things sticking to my shoe are ... oat brans?
Looking back at where she stood seconds ago, some grains are left scattered on the muddy ground.
One can hardly see these with such dim lights.

branch.speaker: Vertin
branch.text: I've jumped over here, but the Shamirs just keep crawling towards the grains.

branch.speaker: Vertin
branch.text: Seems that they are not oriented by sounds. What matters to them is the grain.

branch.speaker: Vertin
branch.text: But I can't stay here forever. There are foods in every corner. They will get here sooner or later.
Itchiness on the leg. Some Shamirs fall on the wool blanket as Vertin pats them off, and hastily crawl away from the blanket.
Others are still wandering by the edge of the wool blanket.

branch.speaker: Vertin
branch.text: Um, they can't do anything to this wool blanket?

items.speaker: Vertin
items.text: Wool ...

items.speaker: Vertin
items.text: Oh, so that's the case ...

items.speaker: Vertin
items.text: The legend says that the way to store Shamir worms is to wrap them in wool and store them in a container made of lead,

items.speaker: Vertin
items.text: which means the wall of this room should be made of ...
Picks up the wool blanket and wipes it on the wall. An off-white mark appears on the blanket.

items.speaker: Vertin
items.text: It's alloy. Quickly forming a film on the surface—this has to be Lead(II) carbonate.

items.speaker: Vertin
items.text: This is poisonous to them ...

items.speaker: Vertin
items.text: Well, to me, as well.
This is when a handkerchief comes in handy. It would make a good mask and glove.

items.speaker: Vertin
items.text: I have everything I need. Grains to lure them and wools to drive them away.

items.speaker: Vertin
items.text: The solutions are more than I expected.

items.speaker: Vertin
items.text: Alright, let's move! Expel them to the corner.
TO BE CONTINUED…
